product_one_liner.value: SiMa.ai combines purpose-built MLSoC hardware and software to build, test, and deploy physical-AI applications on edge devices for developers and organizations building autonomous and industrial systems.

pricing_page.notes: Edgematic publicly lists Free, Premium, and Business plans under Plans & Pricing, even though prices are not displayed.

named_customers.notes: Both appear in the homepage logo wall under “Trusted by industry leaders.”

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists the company size as 201–500 employees.

founded_year.notes: SiMa.ai lists its founding year as 2018.

eng_blog.notes: The blog includes engineering deep dives and GenAI/compiler implementation posts authored by SiMa.ai hardware/software engineering leaders.

public_docs.notes: The public Developer Center links to hardware, software, and examples documentation, and the GenAI documentation has multiple API and tutorial links.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board lists a Principal Engineer, AI & ML Design Verification opening.

model_provider.value: Google Gemma (including Gemma 3 in the documented on-device conversational-AI flow)

compliance_certs.notes: The official quality-policy page makes general quality and regulatory commitments but names none of the listed certifications.

last_funding.notes: The company announced the $150 million Series C on September 28, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 2026 Series C falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current board lists open positions but none is titled SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: Palette SDK 3.0 was announced as released on October 31, 2026, inside the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The current management roster is small; no C-level/VP change in the period was found. The identified Chief Business Officer appointment was announced in October 2023, outside the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable current job board lists open roles but does not name a CRM or sales/marketing platform; Jobvite is the recruiting platform, not a CRM signal.
